cnpcplus.configuration.title: CNPCPlus Config
cnpcplus.configuration.dialogTextColor.t:
Base RGB color for dialog text.
Examples: E0E0E0 / #FFFFFF / FFAA00
Inline & codes override this color.
Default & format prefix for dialog text.
&0-&9 &a-&f colors | &l bold &o italic &n underline &m strike &k obfuscated &r reset
Examples: &l  &6&l  empty=none
cnpcplus.configuration.dialogOptionColor:
Base RGB color for dialog options.
Examples: E0E0E0 / #55FF55
Inline & codes override this color.
cnpcplus.configuration.dialogOptionForma:
Default & format prefix for dialog options.
Examples: &7  &b&o  empty=none
